definitions.ask: Should the coder free athena's full /tmp tmpfs so `npm test` and the /tmp-bound e2e scripts can pass?
definitions.why: Frees the tmpfs all athena agents share and keeps their evidence restorable

choices.label: Moves about 30 GB of stale scratch to ~/.cache/tmp-overflow with a restore manifest
Deletes the same stale scratch; frees about 30 GB, but other agents' evidence is gone for good
Touches nothing outside the repo; npm test and two e2e scripts stay red on athena
